title: A returning browser locked its own IP out for an hour by loading the page
symptom: Background fetches carrying no credential were counted as failed authentication attempts, so five of them tripped the brute-force lock.
root_cause: The lock counted 'request without a valid session' rather than 'request that presented a wrong credential'.
correction_made: Only a presented-and-wrong credential counts; credential-less requests get a plain 401 or the login redirect.
